description.narrative: This activity TradeMark Southern Africa Monitoring and Evaluation/Value for Money costs is a component of Trademark Southern Africa Programme reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £836,102. This project benefits South of Sahara, regional. It works in the following sector(s): Trade facilitation, Road transport, Transport policy and administrative management, Multilateral trade negotiations, Regional trade agreements (RTAs), Information and communication technology (ICT).
